stem: A case supports a contaminated propagation workflow as the main mechanism. Which response is strongest?
choices: Use one pesticide regardless of pathway.
Release all plants after one normal inspection.
Retrain staff only, without checking the workflow.
Combine appropriate hold/movement controls, workflow correction, validated sanitation/process controls, targeted retesting and recovery/effectiveness checks.
rationale: Integrated response should address the evidence-supported pathway and verify effectiveness.
